hero.eyebrow: Digital Media Artist · 15+ Years · Milwaukee, WI · Open for work
hero.subtext: I'm Nate Winter. Fifteen years making products move. Cinematic 3D visualization, brand systems, and packaging — built for the shelf, the feed, and the film. Open for projects and full-time roles.

about.title: Strong creative direction, rendered honestly.
about.lead: I'm a Digital Media Artist based in Milwaukee, with 15+ years across 3D product visualization, brand and packaging design, and motion graphics. I work where design and marketing meet — making products look the way they deserve, in films, in stills, and on every shelf and feed that follows.
about.body1: I started in graphic design, ran in-house creative teams for several years, and went deep on 3D when I realized it was the fastest way to bring an art-directed world to life. The graphic-design foundation is still in everything I ship — it's why the brand and packaging work feels at home next to the renders.
about.body2: Most engagements run 3–8 weeks — a hero film and a stills system, sometimes extending into pack design or a full brand refresh. I'm also open to single deliverables, day-rate creative direction, and ongoing retainers. Smaller briefs are welcome.

services.title: Product animation
services.desc: Cinematic hero films, launch loops, and short-form cutdowns — the headline service. Built on locked art direction so every shot stays of a piece.

services.title: Product stills
services.desc: Cinematic 3D stills for PDPs, paid social, retail signage, and Amazon A+ — drawn from the same visual system as the film, so the campaign reads as one thing.

services.title: Brand & packaging design
services.desc: Identity systems, pack design, and the typography and visual language that earn the shelf. Often paired with a stills library so the brand lands cohesive day one.

services.title: Creative direction & consulting
services.desc: By the day or week. Concept, art direction, design critique, or extra hands on someone else's brief. Lower commitment, same craft.

contact.title: Have a launch on the calendar? Let's talk.
contact.lead: I take a range of projects each quarter — from single deliverables and short engagements to multi-month campaigns and ongoing creative direction. Also open to full-time and contract roles with the right team. Share your scope, timeline, or opportunity — a short note is all I need to get started.
expect: I reply within two business days.
